clips.title: The story
paras: Alba Fairmoon sends you to scout Moonbrook, where signs of industry trouble the Alliance. The poison found across Westfall does not seem to come from the lesser mines, so attention turns to the Deadmines beneath the town.

The mines already examined across Westfall offer no answer to the poison spreading through the region. No known surface excavation appears to be its source. One major site remains unexplored: the vast shafts of the Deadmines, directly beneath Moonbrook’s ruined streets.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Strange - the poison does not seem to originate from the mines you investigated.
I am told the Deadmines under the town of Moonbrook are the largest, deepest mines of Westfall, but they have been abandoned since the First War. Could the Deadmines be active again?
Please travel to Moonbrook, friend, and look for evidence of mining or industrial activity. This is the last lead we have!
